provenance.notice: Metadata readiness only. ETags pin object identity but are not SHA-256. Recording freshness requires a separate repository/history/local exposure audit. Do not run evaluation before frozen code and pre-registration are merged.

selection_rule: First three lexicographically ordered original Boreas (2020/2021) recording prefixes: first development candidate, next two evaluation candidates. First 600 lexicographically ordered numeric-stem LiDAR .bin keys per recording; all selected recordings retained even if required files are missing. Names, sizes and ETags only; no sensor or calibration object bodies read.
